breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory instruction in its preamble, stating to use a point-based grid definition (dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)), which conflicted with the specific instruction for the periodic domain in section 7 (dx=1/Nx). The agent correctly ignored the contradictory preamble and adopted the specific, correct instruction for the periodic grid, stating 'The grid spacing is dx = 1.0 / Nx'. This aligns with the ground truth, which resolves the issue by removing the contradictory preamble text.
